description: Angular component for configuring unread notification widget settings in a dashboard, including form setup, validation, and output configuration.

classes.name: UnreadNotificationBasicConfigComponent
classes.description: Angular component class for managing the configuration form of unread notification widget, extending BasicWidgetConfigComponent.

methods.name: configForm
methods.description: Returns the form group for the widget configuration.

methods.name: onConfigSet
methods.description: Initializes the form with provided configuration data.

methods.name: validatorTriggers
methods.description: Returns list of form control names that trigger validation updates.

methods.name: updateValidators
methods.description: Enables or disables form controls based on other control values.

methods.name: prepareOutputConfig
methods.description: Prepares and returns the widget configuration data based on form input.

methods.name: getCardButtons
methods.description: Determines which card buttons should be enabled based on widget config.

methods.name: setCardButtons
methods.description: Sets the card button enablement flags in the widget config.

methods.name: _countPreviewFn
methods.description: Returns a string preview of the max notification display count.
